limitations.headline: `--force` has no effect.
limitations.expected: Existing files are preserved unless --force is passed
limitations.actual: Scaffolding overwrites any existing file at a target path whether or not `--force` is passed. The flag is accepted, validated, and never read.
limitations.workaround: Commit or back up your work before scaffolding into a directory that already contains files. Run with `--dry-run` first to see which paths are targeted.

limitations.headline: `--dry-run` does not list individual files.
limitations.expected: Every file the run would write is listed
limitations.actual: It lists one path per project and one per solution. A real run creates substantially more files than the preview reports.
limitations.workaround: Use `--dry-run` to confirm where output lands, not what is produced. To see the full file set, scaffold into an empty temporary directory and list it.

limitations.headline: `file.template` has no effect and the file is created empty.
limitations.expected: The named template is rendered into the file
limitations.actual: The key passes schema validation, but content resolution handles only `content` and `source`, so the file is written with no bytes.
limitations.workaround: Use `content:` for inline text, or `source:` for a path to an existing file to copy.

limitations.headline: `gitInit` has no effect.
limitations.expected: A Git repository is initialized in the output directory
limitations.actual: The key is accepted by the schema and validated. No repository is created.
limitations.workaround: Run `git init` in the output directory yourself, or add it to `postScaffoldCommands`.

limitations.headline: `file.encoding` has no effect.
limitations.expected: The file is written in the named encoding
limitations.actual: The key is parsed and validated. Files are always written as UTF-8.
limitations.workaround: None required for UTF-8 output. Convert the file in a `postScaffoldCommands` step if another encoding is needed.

limitations.headline: `dependencies`, `devDependencies`, and `features` have no effect.
limitations.expected: Packages are added to the generated project and named features are enabled
limitations.actual: All three keys are parsed and validated, then ignored. No package reference or feature is emitted.
limitations.workaround: Add packages with a `postScaffoldCommands` entry such as `dotnet add package <name>` or `npm install <name>`.

limitations.headline: `--diagnostics` prints nothing when generation fails.
limitations.expected: Timings are reported whether the run succeeds or fails
limitations.actual: On the root command, the report is rendered after the error-handling block, so a failure skips it. Timings are collected and discarded.
limitations.workaround: Combine with `--verbose` to see the failure detail. Timings for a failing step are available only by re-running the command against a case that succeeds.
